about: The check battery's support-language text: check.<id>.question, .option.<n> and .situation.

strings.check.hear.que-necesitas.question: You hear this at the stall. What does it mean?
strings.check.hear.que-necesitas.option.1: The shopkeeper asks what you need.
strings.check.hear.quieres-pan.question: You hear this at the stall. What does it mean?
strings.check.hear.quieres-pan.option.1: The shopkeeper asks what you need.
strings.check.hear.quieres-pan.option.2: The shopkeeper says the river is over there.
strings.check.hear.pedir-agua.question: You hear this from a customer. What does it mean?
strings.check.hear.si-por-favor.question: You hear this. What does it mean?
strings.check.hear.no-gracias.question: You hear this. What does it mean?
strings.check.hear.donde-esta-el-rio.question: You hear this from a traveler. What does it mean?
strings.check.hear.quieres-fruta.question: A guide says this to you. What does it mean?
strings.check.hear.quieres-fruta.option.1: She asks where the river is.
strings.check.hear.necesitas-madera.question: A guide says this to you at her camp. What does it mean?
strings.check.hear.necesitas-madera.option.2: You need a torch and a bottle.
strings.check.hear.me-llamo.question: A guide says this when you meet. What does it mean?
strings.check.hear.es-madera.question: A guide holds up a log and says this. What does it mean?
strings.check.hear.es-madera.option.1: She asks if it is wood.
strings.check.hear.es-madera.option.2: She asks if you want some wood.
strings.check.hear.es-madera.option.3: She says it is a table.
strings.check.hear.de-nada.question: You say “gracias” and a guide answers like this. What does it mean?
strings.check.hear.que-quieres.question: A guide says this to you. What does it mean?
strings.check.hear.que-quieres.option.1: The guide asks what you want.
strings.check.hear.que-quieres.option.2: The guide asks where the river is.
strings.check.hear.tienes-fruta.question: A guide says this to you. What does it mean?
strings.check.hear.tienes-fruta.option.1: The guide asks if you have a fruit.
strings.check.hear.tienes-fruta.option.2: The guide says the wood is for the torch.
strings.check.hear.tienes-fruta.option.3: The guide offers you some fruit.
strings.check.hear.que-quieren-ustedes.question: A shopkeeper says this to you and a friend. What does it mean?
strings.check.hear.que-quieren-ustedes.option.1: She asks what you both want.
strings.check.hear.que-quieren-ustedes.option.3: She says goodbye to you both.
strings.check.say.pedir-agua.situation: You are at a market stall. You want water. Ask for it politely.
strings.check.say.si-por-favor.situation: The shopkeeper offers you bread. You want it.
strings.check.say.no-gracias.situation: The shopkeeper offers you bread. You don't want it. Say no politely.
strings.check.say.donde-esta-el-rio.situation: You are in a village and need to find the river. Ask a villager.
strings.check.say.si.situation: A guide holds up a log and asks if it is wood. Answer yes.
strings.check.say.no.situation: A guide holds up a log and asks if it is water. Answer no.
strings.check.say.que-es-esto.situation: A guide points at a plant you do not know. Ask her what it is.
strings.check.say.otra-vez.situation: A guide spoke too fast and you did not catch it. Ask her to say it again.
strings.check.say.mas-despacio.situation: A guide spoke too fast. Ask her to say it again more slowly.
strings.check.say.quiero-madera.situation: A guide asks what you want. You want wood. Say so.
strings.check.say.tengo-fruta.situation: A guide asks if you have a fruit. You do. Say yes and say that you have one.
strings.check.say.ella-quiere-fruta.situation: A friend asks what Luna wants. She wants fruit. Say what she wants.
strings.check.say.necesitamos-agua.situation: A friend asks what you both need. You need water. Say it for the two of you.
strings.check.hear.que-vas-a-comer.question: A villager says this to you. What does it mean?
strings.check.hear.que-vas-a-comer.option.1: He asks what you are going to eat tomorrow.
strings.check.hear.que-vas-a-comer.option.2: He asks what you ate yesterday.
strings.check.hear.que-vas-a-comer.option.3: He says there is bread at the stall.
strings.check.hear.que-comiste-ayer.question: A shopkeeper says this to you. What does it mean?
strings.check.hear.que-comiste-ayer.option.1: She asks what you ate yesterday.
strings.check.hear.que-comiste-ayer.option.2: She asks what you are going to eat tomorrow.
strings.check.hear.que-comiste-ayer.option.3: She says the bread is ready.
strings.check.say.voy-a-comer-pan.situation: A villager asks what you are going to eat tomorrow. You will eat bread. Say so.
strings.check.say.ayer-comi-fruta.situation: A shopkeeper asks what you ate yesterday. You ate fruit. Say so.
